title: Conditional Generation Models
summary: This module provides a collection of models for generating various outputs such as text, speech, or images conditioned on diverse inputs, supporting tasks like translation, summarization, and speech recognition.

nodes.label: Text-to-Text Generation
nodes.title: Text-to-Text Generation
nodes.description: Models focused on generating text outputs from text inputs, often used for tasks like translation and summarization.

nodes.label: Speech-to-Text Generation
nodes.title: Speech-to-Text Generation
nodes.description: Models that transcribe spoken language into written text, converting audio inputs into textual outputs.

nodes.label: Text-to-Speech Generation
nodes.title: Text-to-Speech Generation
nodes.description: Models that synthesize speech from text inputs, enabling verbal output from written content.

nodes.label: Speech-to-Speech Generation
nodes.title: Speech-to-Speech Generation
nodes.description: Models that translate spoken language from one language to another, directly generating speech output from speech input.

nodes.label: Vision-to-Text Generation
nodes.title: Vision-to-Text Generation
nodes.description: Models that interpret visual inputs (images/videos) and generate descriptive text or perform visual question answering.

nodes.label: Multi-Modal Generation
nodes.title: Multi-Modal Generation
nodes.description: Models capable of processing and generating content across multiple modalities, such as text, audio, and visual data.

nodes.label: Protein Sequence Generation
nodes.title: Protein Sequence Generation
nodes.description: Models specialized in generating text outputs related to protein sequences, often for biological analysis.

groups.label: Generative Models
groups.title: Generative Models
groups.description: Core models and architectures for various conditional generation tasks across different modalities.
